### Mod Information:
* Champion: Dr. Mundo
* Modified skin: Default
* Author: お兄ちゃんの苗床
* Description: Replaces base Mundo with Hanazono Yurine from Jashin-Chan Dropkick

ゆりねちゃんのマチェットぺろぺろしたい。。。ぺろぺろぺろぺろ

### Features:
* New model and texture
* Supports all champion texture quality settings
* Modified loadingscreen
* Modified in-game/skill icons
* Modified particles
* Modified animations
* Edited ability sounds
* New voiceover replacing Mundo's 150+ lines

### Credits
* Model from 300 Heroes
* Visual assets from Jashin-Chan Dropkick anime, manga and assorted official art
* Voiceover from Jashin-Chan Dropkick anime and assorted game collaborations (Girls' Frontline, Clover Theater)
* Ult background music 邪神ちゃんドロップキックのテーマですの from Jashin-Chan Dropkick
* Death background music クソリコーダーですの from Jashin-chan Dropkick
* Dance background music Anokoni Dropkick from Jashin-Chan Dropkick OP1
